name: [⚡DARK THUNDER] Rogue Demon
desc:
🚨360K LIKES FOR NEXT CODE! 🚨
RECENT CODES (PRESS P IN GAME):
FREEMOVESETS
350KLIKES

Inspired by the show, "Demon Slayer".

Keybinds for keyboard users can be found on the bottom right corner of the screen.

Note: Some skills are required to be held, aimed, or used with M2.

CONTROLLER BINDS:
Left Thumbstick - Navigate interface (when cursor is unlocked)
Hold RB + face buttons to use skills
Hold LB + face buttons to use the variant of the skills
RT for light attack
LT for heavy attack
